shell_commands: npm run prettier -- --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "(formatted|checked)"

git add package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(tools): compile tool schemas at registration time

- Add ajv validator to dependencies (strict: false, validateFormats: false)
- Compile static tool schemas at register() time and throw synchronously if invalid
- Include tool name in the error message for easier debugging
- Function-valued definitions will be compiled per call in subsequent facets
EOF
)"
